claim: E3M1 cuts its streets at shadow edges that run along one sun. Measured for Gravesend's resolution.py (2026-09-02, no counter kept, not recounted): of 112 shade boundaries in its street surface, 60 axis-aligned and 20 oblique between 52 and 84 degrees, median 84 (Build angle 478); street shades 8 lit, 24 penumbra, 32-34 shadow, 44 for the quay and far bank. A recount over its sky street at or below grade (2026-11-26) finds 16 shade boundaries, 7 of them oblique at 82.9-86.4 degrees, median 84.2, and shades 8, 24, 32-34 and 44.

the shadow length equal to the mass's height is a convention (resolution.py SUN_SHADOW_PER_HEIGHT: 'Blood has no real sun elevation'), not a measurement
use: Cast every mass's shadow on one bearing; cut a surface only where a shadow crosses it. Length equal to height is our convention, not a measured one.
